Trombonist Art Baron was born in Bridgeport, Connecticut on January 5, 1950.

His versatility has enabled him to perform with a long list of jazz and popular artists including Stevie Wonder, Frank Wess, Bruce Springsteen and the Duke Ellington Orchestra. His composition “Urban Kaleidoscope” was premiered by the Lincoln Center Jazz Orchestra in 1995.
Art was interviewed in Clinton, New York on April 13, 2008 before a concert with the Harlem Blues and Jazz Band, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
